evidence: docusaurus.config.js pins i18n.defaultLocale to zh-Hans and baseUrl to /.
The root index page declares canonical https://docs.zilliz.com.cn/.
migration/reports/routes-zh-CN-legacy.json captures this route tree while excluding the secondary zh-CN directory.

secondaryLocaleDuplicate.canonicalBehavior: Each ordinary secondary canonical is the matching root canonical with /zh-CN inserted. The /404 canonical uses .html in both trees and /home has no canonical in either tree.
evidence: A fresh isolated npm run build produced 3372 raw routes: 1686 root routes plus 1686 secondary-locale routes.
A route-by-route comparison of kind and redirect target found zero differences.
The isolated assembled Docusaurus build logged en and ja-JP as its only locales.
The assembled output has no zh-CN tree, so it is not used as the Chinese replacement route baseline.
